law: Ministry of Technology and Communications Decision No. 3643

refuter_votes.reason: The text requires a backup-data system located in Lao PDR when foreign cloud infrastructure is used. In the context of cloud-service technical standards, that is a concrete local-system requirement attached to providing the service, not merely confidentiality or generic domestic processing.

With hunt_in empty, the rubric’s scoring controls: a local infrastructure requirement as a service precondition scores 1. The conditional foreign-cloud case requires an in-country backup system; the text says it must be present. This is more than merely recording a rule for an already-established data centre or a copy on rented capacity.

Article 21’s technical standards say that when foreign cloud infrastructure is used, a backup-data collection system must be located in Lao PDR. The text does not specify a data centre or server, but it supports a local-system requirement in that conditional service context; it does not establish a blanket localization duty.
